content.short: Philidor scores and monitors DeFi vaults and tokenized funds, issuing signed risk decisions.
content.description: Philidor assesses vaults and tokenized funds, mapping what each product actually depends on underneath and issuing signed risk decisions against a client's own policy. Dependency mapping is the useful part: yield products routinely wrap other yield products, and the real exposure is often several layers below what the front end advertises.
content.meta: Maps what a vault actually depends on underneath and issues signed risk decisions against policy.
